plan: Identical six to party_magma_60.json; only the lead order changes. The room's whole idea is a Gale Wings priority Tailwind on turn 1, and the crack is to answer it before it resolves. Fake Out is +3 priority and Gale Wings Tailwind is +1, so Incineroar's Fake Out beats it outright, and Zapdos's Thunderbolt is 2x into Talonflame's Flying half on the same turn. Zapdos is also immune to Nidoqueen's Sheer Force Earth Power and its Heat Wave answers the Poison pair, so it is the right body to have on the field from turn 0 here.
